problem_type: A shot state derivation reported progress (queued / stopped) for work the user had not yet approved, because "no job yet" and "job still at the human gate" were read as "waiting in the queue"
symptom: After the user said 先别生成 and the agent only called draft_shots, the new canvas node showed 排队中 · 第 1/1 (and the task button lit up), which reads as queued and about to spend money. On disk at that moment: Run draft, plan draft (cardHidden), 0 jobs, 0 gates, ledger 0, 0 provider requests.
direct_cause: deriveProductionShotState (then shotPlaceholderState) mapped every shot without a job — and every job still in planned / authorization_required — to queued unless the run was stopped; only unticked shots were excluded.
class_root: The shot-phase owner had no notion of "has the user let this request go out". The fact existed only inside the batch scheduler (authorization_required is still waiting for a human) and in the plan state (submitted), so every pre-approval state — draft_shots draft, priced card waiting, confirm_all shot gate, rework awaiting its card, draft cancelled before dispatch — fell through to queued or stopped.
affected_population: Every agent draft created by draft_shots while the user has not asked to generate
Every priced card waiting for the user, every confirm_all shot waiting on its own gate, every rework waiting on its confirmation, every draft cancelled before dispatch
entry_points: Main-process canvas landing projection (multiShotCanvasLanding.buildMaterializeShotsPayload) writing node run records
internal_only_reason: The invariant is Nomi's own generation lifecycle (plan state and job status machine in electron/productionRun/productionRunState.ts); no third-party library or external format decides it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: It is already the single owner of "which phase is this shot in" for both the main-process landing projection and the renderer placeholder (#870); the pre-approval rule belongs to that same judgment.

invariants: A shot is reported queued or stopped only if its latest job has passed the human gate, or it has no job and the plan is submitted with the shot included.
jobAwaitsHuman is an exhaustive Record over ProductionJobStatus, so a new status cannot silently fall into queued.

door_reduction.why_not: All remaining doors are readers of the one owner (productionShotPhase): the landing projection, the placeholder and the scheduler render or act in different processes. Before this change the scheduler kept its own authorization_required literal; now it reads jobAwaitsHuman.

generality_proof: Both canvas surfaces (main-process node run records and the renderer placeholder) and the scheduler read productionShotPhase, so every pre-approval state is decided once. jobAwaitsHuman is exhaustive, and isShotInDispatchedScope keys on plan.state === submitted plus included, which covers drafts, sealed-but-unapproved plans, cancelled drafts and unticked shots with one rule.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Returns null for any shot the user has not let go out yet.
Exhaustive answer to "is this job still waiting at the human gate".

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls deriveProductionShotState; a null phase writes no run record, so the node stays an ordinary idle node.
Renders the queued / stopped chips only from deriveProductionShotState, which now returns null before approval.
Reads jobAwaitsHuman instead of its own authorization_required literal.
#869 already excludes cardHidden drafts from the task list (isProductionRunTask) and files a waiting card under attention; it does not claim queued.

recurrence.reason: Every draft_shots draft, priced-card wait, confirm_all shot gate and rework confirmation reached the same fall-through; any new pre-approval job status would too without an exhaustive table.
same_class_scan: rg "included === false" electron/shared -> the only prior exclusion in deriveProductionShotState (replaced by isShotInDispatchedScope)

prevention.invariant: Queued and stopped are reported only after the user approved the current request.
prevention.failure_mode: Before approval the shot phase is null and every surface shows nothing.
prevention.strategy: Put the pre-approval rule inside the existing single owner and make the human-gate classification exhaustive over job statuses; the scheduler reads the same table.

legacy_paths.rationale: The fall-through was a missing branch, not a parallel path; the scheduler literal was replaced in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls plan or job lifecycle.

migration: No stored data changes; the phase is derived on every read.
residual_risks: The canvas batch bar (生成全部 N 个) reads raw node.status (TODO T-AG-24).
A finished single agent image keeps the task button lit because the run waits for rough-cut review (TODO T-AG-25).
Dispatched-but-not-yet-running shots still use the batch-specific queued chip (#870 decision), while the 2026-09-24 mockup had proposed the ordinary waiting surface; to be settled with the user.
